answer: Duplicate or low-effort identities burn their bond on exit, so a comet of fake accounts costs attackers real capital per head, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest agents recover their stake. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond of umber tokens before voting, and the protocol raises the minimum bond whenever the active identity count spikes on a single knoll of new registrations.
